patient.answer: Hospitechverse is a Hospital Management System (HMS) that streamlines appointments, billing, inventory, prescriptions, queue management, and reporting for clinics and hospitals. It provides role-based access for patients, doctors, and administrators along with a patient portal and director/admin panels.

To book an appointment, go to the Appointments page, choose a doctor and available slot, fill your details, and confirm. You will receive a confirmation and an appointment ID by email or in your account.
Click 'Forgot password' on the login page, enter your registered email, and follow the instructions sent to your inbox to reset your password.
Open your Patient Portal, go to 'Prescriptions' to view issued prescriptions. You can download or print them from the prescription detail view.
Go to 'Billing' or 'Receipts' in your account, select the invoice, and click Download or Print to get a PDF copy of your invoice or receipt.
In your patient profile use the 'Upload Reports' section to attach PDFs or images. Supported formats include PNG, JPG, PDF and they are stored under your uploads for clinicians to review.
Hospitechverse supports online payments through configured gateways (like Razorpay) and offline payments recorded by staff. Check the Billing page or contact the clinic for enabled methods.
For help contact the clinic admin or director. For technical support email support@iitiancraft.com with your tenant name and a brief description of the issue.
Open the appointment in your Patient Portal and choose Cancel. If cancellation is restricted by policy, contact clinic reception or admin to request cancellation.
Check the Appointments page in your patient account to see upcoming, completed, or cancelled appointments and their details.
Refunds policies are set by the clinic. Contact billing or admin via the Billing page or email support@iitiancraft.com with your invoice details to request a refund.
Lab reports uploaded by the clinic appear in your Reports section. Open a report to view or download it as a PDF or image.
Go to your Profile settings and edit contact details like phone, email and address. Save changes and verify if an OTP/email confirmation is required.
Prescription templates are managed by clinicians. Patients can view templates used for issued prescriptions in the Prescription section if the clinic exposes them.
Hospitechverse stores data securely and uses access controls. For tenant-specific security policies, contact your clinic admin or review the tenant's privacy documentation.

patient.keyword: how to upload image for doctor
patient.answer: Use the Patient Portal 'Upload Reports' to attach images (X-rays, photos). Choose the file and submit; the doctor can view these in the patient record.
Visit 'Billing' or 'Receipts' in your account to see a list of invoices and receipts along with payment statuses and downloadable PDFs.

patient.keyword: how to share reports with doctor
patient.answer: Upload reports to your profile and mention in appointment notes, or use the messaging/queries feature (if enabled) to notify the doctor to review the uploaded files.
Open the prescription in your account and use the Print or Download PDF option. Alternatively, the prescription can be emailed to you for printing.
Use the language selector usually at the top-right of the portal to change UI language. Some clinics may restrict certain translations; contact admin if missing.

doctor.answer: Open the Doctor Dashboard or Appointments page. You can filter by date, status and see patient details, visit notes, and start consultations from there.
In a patient's record click 'New Prescription', select medicines from inventory or templates, add dosage and instructions, then save and issue the prescription.
Use the Attendance or Doctor Attendance page to mark yourself present. Some setups allow one-click marking or require admin verification depending on tenant settings.
Go to Availability settings and configure weekly schedule, slots and leave. Changes reflect on the public booking calendar for patients to pick available slots.
Open the Patients section and search by name or ID. Select the patient to view clinical history, past prescriptions, lab reports and appointment notes.
While viewing a consultation or patient record, use the notes field to add visit findings, advice, and follow-up instructions. Save notes to keep a record for future visits.
Add lab test orders from the prescription or orders section and select preferred lab or sample collection details as configured by the clinic.
Create or select a prescription template in the Templates area, edit as needed during consultation, and issue it to the patient with one click.
Start video/audio consultation from the appointment entry if the tenant enables teleconsultation. Ensure your camera and mic permissions are allowed in the browser.
Patient-uploaded files appear in the patient record under 'Files' or 'Reports'. Click a file to preview or download for review before consultation.
Use the referral or notes option to generate a referral letter with selected patient details and recommended next steps. Share via email or print as needed.
From the appointment or billing screen add services, medicines and apply discounts. Generate an invoice and mark the payment method to complete billing.
Open Inventory or Pharmacy module to view current stock, low-stock alerts and purchase recommendations. Only users with inventory access can edit stock levels.
Go to Leave Requests and submit a new request with dates and reason. Admins or directors review and approve based on policy.
Use the Reports section to export CSV or PDF summaries for the chosen date range and filters. Export options are available per-report type.

general.answer: To purchase Hospitechverse for your clinic, contact sales via the website or email support@iitiancraft.com. The sales team will provide pricing, deployment options (cloud or on-premise), and onboarding details.
Pricing depends on tenant size and selected modules. Request a pricing quote from sales; there are SaaS plans and enterprise options with different limits and features.
Yes — request a live demo or trial through our contact page or email support@iitiancraft.com. We can schedule a guided walkthrough specific to your workflow.
Hospitechverse can export billing and receipts data to common accounting formats (CSV). Enterprise integrations or custom connectors can be implemented on request.
Backup policies depend on the deployment. Cloud tenants receive automated backups; on-premise deployments should configure local backups. Contact support for a backup plan.
Hospitechverse supports multi-tenant SaaS setups where each tenant (clinic) has isolated data, configurable plans, and role-based access control.
Yes — the system supports customization of workflows, templates, branding, and reports. Contact support@iitiancraft.com to discuss customization scope and costs.
An API and webhook mechanism is available for integrations (e.g., notifications, sync). Contact technical support to provision API keys and view documentation.
We support popular payment gateways like Razorpay. Admins can configure gateway credentials in tenant settings to enable online payments.
Onboarding includes tenant setup, data import, and optional training sessions for staff. Training packages are provided during implementation planning.
Support response times depend on your plan. Enterprise customers get prioritized SLAs. Contact support@iitiancraft.com to learn about service tiers.
Export patient, billing, and report data via the export tools in each module. Data is provided in CSV or PDF formats for external processing.
For cloud deployments, standard browsers are sufficient. On-premise installs require a server with specs depending on number of users — we'll provide guidance during sales.
Trial durations are agreed during demo/sales. Contact sales to request a trial tenant to evaluate features with sample data.
For enterprise or bulk licensing contact support@iitiancraft.com or your assigned sales representative for custom pricing and deployment planning.
